name: Gremlin Academy
source:
Welcome to John Thomas University, affectionately known as Gremlin Academy.
It’s a place with tons of guys looking to get laid.
Meet Baz as he explores John Thomas University and acclimates himself to his new setting and tries to fit in.
translation:
欢迎来到被大家亲切地称作“小恶魔学院”的约翰·托马斯大学。
这里遍地都是急着寻欢作乐的小伙子。
跟随巴兹一同探索约翰·托马斯大学，看他如何适应这片崭新的天地、努力融入大家吧。
